content.comment_body: Hello, I have set up an S7 connection between the [product_name] and [product_name] [version_no]. The [product_name] acts as a client and can read/write data blocks on the [version_no] successfully. Now I am looking for ways to perform diagnostics. When the connection fails, the display on the [product_name] turns red to show an error. I tried using a network input and set the parameter to "Ethernet network error," but it isn't working. Is there a way to check the connection status without relying on data exchange bits? Thanks.

I'm also interested in achieving such a connection between [product_name] and [version_no]. Could you share your project here? In the meantime, you might consider toggling a bit from the [version_no] and resetting it with the [product_name], similar to heartbeat monitoring found in HMIs.

There really isn't a reliable way. Using a Network Input block with Diagnostics enabled and selecting "Ethernet link error" as the diagnostic type works only if the [product_name] is directly connected to the [version_no]. If they're connected through a network switch and the link to the [version_no] drops, an error won't be reported because the [product_name] is still connected to the network switch.
That's absolutely right. So, the best way to monitor the connection reliably is to use a heartbeat bit.
If you want to diagnose the network status, you need a Network Input block. To monitor the status of S7 Communication specifically, a heartbeat bit is necessary.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are seeking methods to monitor and diagnose the Ethernet connection status between a [product_name] acting as client and a [product_name] [version_no]. Existing diagnostic options do not provide consistent notifications when network issues occur, especially in scenarios involving a network switch. Users recommend implementing a heartbeat or lifetime bit for reliable connection status monitoring. There is dissatisfaction with the limited effectiveness of current diagnostic features for typical network setups.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to reliably monitor the connection status between [product_name] and [version_no], ensuring they receive clear error alerts when the connection is lost, regardless of network configuration.
